provenance.export: Original score fields preserved and verified; added confidence/resource metrics recomputed from authenticated saved predictions without new model inference.

training_notes: Pretrained model weights remained frozen during this benchmark.
Linear classifier baselines were fitted using benchmark training examples; kNN used labeled training examples.
interpretation: Descriptive snapshot; no significance tests or new uncertainty claims.
Heldout accuracy counts absent/invalid answers as incorrect. ECE uses available selected-answer confidences only; Brier requires full distributions. Confidence and probability coverage are explicit.
T1 reference uses its restricted cohort, not all388 or all114. Old shortlist adapters are separate from actual LangGraph studies.
Attempt coverage includes unsupported/model-error outcomes and does not imply valid responses or success.
Additional metrics are recomputed from the same authenticated saved predictions; pretrained models were not rerun.
Confidence, latency and token availability are reported explicitly; missing observations are not replaced with zero.
Selected-answer Brier uses confidence only; multiclass Brier still requires a genuine full probability distribution.
Reference uniform/majority zero latency values are placeholders and excluded from measured timing.
Allocation costs cover complete retained MCQA shard allocations, not isolated held-out questions or subgroups; they are estimates, not final billed charges.

tariff.source_capture: Unmodified local SCITAS tariff configuration copied before the export job.
tariff.note: MIG units are allocated slices, not full-GPU equivalents. Recorded charges may differ, including failure-related billing policies.

definitions.gpu_allocation_hours: Sum of terminal allocation ElapsedRaw seconds times generic gres/gpu units, divided by 3600; includes MIG slice-hours, not physical full-GPU equivalents or active kernel time.
definitions.gpu_cost_chf_estimate: Terminal GPU allocation hours times the installed site partition tariff; an estimate, not a recorded charge or invoice.
definitions.known_partial_totals: Known terminal worker totals only; missing or nonterminal allocations are not treated as zero.
definitions.scope: Retained authenticated MCQA shard allocations for the full method cohort (normally 388 questions; T1 reference 208), including startup, model loading and allocation overhead. Excludes sequential/graph runs, environment setup, model downloads, feature fitting, domain folds and discarded attempts. Allocation time cannot be attributed exactly to held-out or category/menu-size subgroups.

metric_definitions.binary_brier_selected_correctness: Mean (selected-answer confidence - correctness)^2 over available valid confidence rows.
metric_definitions.confidence_coverage: Available confidence rows / all cohort questions.
metric_definitions.correctness_auroc: Probability that a correct answer receives higher confidence than an incorrect answer, with half credit for ties; null without both classes.
metric_definitions.selective_curve: One point per confidence threshold including all ties; accuracy=correct accepted/accepted, coverage=accepted/full subgroup size. Descriptive held-out curve, not a validation-fitted deployment guarantee.
metric_definitions.latency: Observed backend/pipeline wall time; excludes explicit zero reference placeholders. Direct timing normally excludes model loading; first expert-to-native calls may include lazy chooser initialization.
metric_definitions.tokens: Known top-level input/output token sums and per-field coverage. Sampling totals already include all draws; expert/chooser totals already include both stages. Do not double-add nested records.
metric_definitions.feature_usage: Feature methods record cold-encoding tokens only and include cache/CPU work in wall timing. Token units differ between encoders; zero generated output tokens is valid.
metric_definitions.api_cost_usd: Zero hosted API spend for these local configurations; not a measured GPU cost.
metric_definitions.gpu_allocation_hours: Allocated GPU units multiplied by Slurm elapsed hours for retained dedicated MCQA shard jobs. A MIG unit is a slice, not a full-GPU equivalent.
metric_definitions.gpu_cost_chf_estimate: Full retained MCQA allocation hours multiplied by installed SCITAS partition tariff. Estimate only; excludes preparation/fitting/downloads/other tracks/unretained attempts.
metric_definitions.subgroup_allocation: Held-out and task/choice subgroups share whole-job allocations; GPU allocation and monetary cost remain null for these subgroups. No latency-based prorating is invented.
metric_definitions.actual_invoiced_cost_chf: Unavailable; tariff estimates are not invoices.
